notes: Fig. 5(a) is the N = 5 schematic; finger positions are from the micrograph Fig. 5(b), a 9-pass device with L = 90 um (device 4). The extra 200 um of device 5 is added between the fingers.
Dummy metal fill squares and the unlabelled darker rectangle around the heater in Fig. 5(b) are not drawn: their extent for L = 290 um is not known.
Stems beyond 30 um are not in the micrograph: run out to the stated 800 um. Fig. 5(a) marks a single input and output; the adiabatic coupler region of ref. [22] is not detailed here.
